title: Homogeneous generator formulas for the canonical ordered shifted character composites
statement: Let $A$ be a commutative condensed ring, $G$ any profinite group, $D$ the resolution of [lem-sfb-condensed-internal-bar-resolution], and $P$, transported components, $e$ and orderedIterate the actual constructions of [def-sfb-internal-bar-character-data], in the sizes and internal module categories of [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring, sk-def-sfb-module-objects, def-sfb-condensed-action-module, def-weil-size-convention]. Suppose a family $L_a:P\to P[1]$ satisfies IsLift for each additive condensed character $a$ of [def-sfb-condensed-unipotent-class]. Its transported components satisfy $\partial L+L\partial=0$. For every list $a=(a_1,\ldots,a_q)$, the actual recursively constructed $F_a$ is componentwise equivariant, is zero in degrees $-n$ with $n<q$, and sends a generalized generator $[g_0,\dots,g_{n+q}]$ to $(\prod_{k=1}^q a_k(g_{k-1}^{-1}g_k))[g_q,\dots,g_{n+q}]$. Its actual augmented component $f_a=e[q]F_a:D_q\to A$ is equivariant, satisfies $\partial_{q+1};f_a=0$, equals the original augmentation for the empty list, and sends $[g_0,\dots,g_q]$ to $\prod_{k=1}^q a_k(g_{k-1}^{-1}g_k)$. These identities hold after all profinite base changes; no internal-function diagram is used.

proof.text: Transport the cochain-map equation of each L through the term and shift isomorphisms. The one-shift differential is minus the original differential, giving the anticommutation equation.

Induct on $q$ with $F_0=1_P$ and $F_{q+1}=L_{a_{q+1}}[q]F_q$. The shifted map has the same component maps as $L_{a_{q+1}}$, with reindexed degrees: multiplying its anticommutation equation by $(-1)^q$ gives the map equation between $P[q]$ and $P[q+1]$. Hence each $F_q$ is a cochain map by composition. For the generator formula the case $q=0$ is the empty product $1$. If $n<q$ the component is already zero. If $n=q$, the next map is $L_{a_{q+1}}^0=0$. If $n\geq q+1$, apply $L_{a_{q+1},n-q}$ to the inductive formula: $A$-linearity multiplies its coefficient by $a_{q+1}(g_q^{-1}g_{q+1})$ and deletes $g_q$. This is precisely the displayed ordered product for $F_{q+1}$, with no permutation of the characters. Equality on all generators gives equality of the internal maps.

Equivariance follows by composition of the componentwise equivariant lifts, starting with the identity. The augmented component is the corresponding composite with the equivariant original augmentation.

The augmentation $e$ of [lem-sfb-condensed-internal-bar-resolution] is a cochain map: its sole component is $P_0\to A$, and $e\partial_1=0$. Consequently $e[q]F_q:P\to A[q]$ is a cochain map. Since $A[q]$ is concentrated in degree $-q$, its sole possibly nonzero component is $f_q:P_q\to A$, and its map equation in degree $-q-1$ is $f_q\partial_{q+1}=0$. Applying the augmentation to the generator formula gives $f_q[g_0,\ldots,g_q]=\prod_{k=1}^q a_k(g_{k-1}^{-1}g_k)$. For $q=0$ this is $f_0=e$ and value $1$.
